text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text in a useful way. For example, NLP can translate words from one language into another quickly and accurately. It can also perform sentiment analysis, which means it discovers whether a piece of writing is positive, negative or neutral. This is very helpful for companies that want to know what customers think about their products. Another common use of NLP is chatbots, which are computer programs that can talk with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, these systems are becoming smarter and more helpful every year.
